exposure: giant luteinized follicular cyst of pregnancy
surgical intervention (cesarean delivery and cyst removal)
cohort: A 17-year-old primigravida diagnosed with a giant luteinized follicular cyst during pregnancy.
finding: A giant luteinized follicular cyst of pregnancy, growing from 632 ml to 2600 ml during gestation, was successfully removed via cesarean delivery at 37 weeks and 6 days.
mod_finding: Fetal extraction and the large adnexal cyst were removed by cesarean delivery.
gest_age: Gestational age at diagnosis was 10 weeks and 2 days, and delivery occurred at 37 weeks and 6 days.
